title: CVE-2026-134624: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
text: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

title: CVE-2025-42884: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
text: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

title: CVE-2026-133968: Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability
text: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

title: CVE-2026-123890: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
text: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.
